createGuildDescription: Guilds group initiatives and projects. You can invite teammates after creation.
reorderHint: Drag guilds to reorder them, then tap Done.

leave.title: Leave {{name}}?
leave.description: You will lose access to all initiatives and projects in <bold>{{name}}</bold>. This action cannot be undone.
leave.lastAdminWarning: You are the last admin of this guild. Promote another member to admin first.
leave.failedToLeave: Failed to leave guild. Please try again.
leave.failedToCheckEligibility: Failed to check eligibility. Please try again.
leave.ownershipReleased: Anything you own in this guild becomes unowned. A guild admin can claim it later.

removeMember.title: Remove member from guild
removeMember.description: Remove {{email}} from this guild? They'll lose access to every initiative and project in it.
removeMember.failedToRemove: Failed to remove member. Please try again.
removeMember.ownershipReleased: Anything they own becomes unowned. You can claim it any time from the unowned content list below.

invite.title: Join {{guildName}}
invite.couldNotValidate: This invite could not be validated.
invite.alreadyHaveAccount: If you already have an account, sign in and accept the invite.
invite.accepted: Invite accepted! You now have access to this guild.
invite.unableToLoad: Unable to load invite details. Please try again later.
invite.unableToAccept: Unable to accept invite right now.

settings.title: Guild Settings
settings.dangerDescription: Irreversible actions for this guild. Proceed with caution.
settings.deleteGuildIntro: Deleting <bold>{{name}}</bold> is permanent and cannot be undone. It will remove everything in the guild, including:
settings.deleteWhatDocuments: All documents and their version history
settings.deleteWhatMembers: All guild memberships and pending invites
settings.deleteConfirmDescription: Deleting <bold>{{name}}</bold> will permanently remove all initiatives, projects, tasks, documents, members, invites, and settings within it. This cannot be undone.
settings.retentionDescription: How long deleted items stay in the trash before they're permanently removed. Set to "Never" to keep them until an admin manually deletes them.
settings.discoveryDescription: A listed guild appears in the directory, where anyone signed in can find it and join without an invite.
settings.discoveryCategoriesHint: Pick the subjects that describe this guild. They decide which shelves it appears under.
settings.discoveryCapacityBlocked: This guild has room for only one person, so nobody could join it from the directory. Ask your platform operator to raise its member limit.
settings.discoveryNotListed: Not listed. Only people with an invite can join.
settings.autoJoinPromptTitle: New members will arrive to an empty guild
settings.autoJoinPromptBody: Joining this guild puts nobody in an initiative, and an initiative's contents stay hidden until someone is in it. Pick where newcomers should land.
settings.autoJoinPromptEffect: The initiative you pick becomes joinable by anyone in the guild, and everyone who joins the guild from now on is added to it. Members already here are not added.
settings.autoJoinPromptDone: New guild members will now land in {{name}}.
settings.autoJoinPromptCreateHint: To welcome people somewhere new instead, create an initiative, then turn on auto-join in its Joining settings.

artwork.title: Pictures
artwork.failed: That picture could not be saved.
artwork.tooLarge: That file is too large to work with. Try one under 12 MB.
artwork.unreadable: That image could not be read.
artwork.iconHint: Any image. It is cropped square and resized for you.
artwork.bannerHint: Any image. It is cropped to 4:1 and resized for you — around 2400 × 600 works best.
artwork.bannerColorHint: The fill shows when there is no banner image. Banner text is black or white so it stays readable on any fill, and follows the fill's best contrast until you change it.
artwork.bannerColorOnly: This guild's plan doesn't include banner images. Pick a colour below instead.

users.adminRequired: You need admin permissions to view this page.
users.invitesDescription: Generate links to invite new members.
users.inviteSeatsFull: All {{max}} seats are in use. Remove a member, or ask a platform admin to raise the limit, before creating another invite.
users.inviteSeatsFullPlan_one: The {{plan}} plan includes a single seat, and it's taken. Upgrade to invite people into this guild.
users.inviteSeatsFullPlan_other: All {{count}} seats on the {{plan}} plan are in use. Upgrade to invite more people.
users.inviteSeatsFullUpgrade_one: Your plan includes a single seat, and it's taken. Upgrade to invite people into this guild.
users.inviteSeatsFullUpgrade_other: All {{count}} seats on your plan are in use. Upgrade to invite more people.
users.removeUserDescription: This will remove {{email}} from the guild. This cannot be undone.

noGuild.title: No guild membership
noGuild.description: You are not a member of any guild yet. Ask a guild admin for an invite link, or create a new guild to get started.

notifications.exportReady: Your export is ready — click to download.

notifications.importReady: Your import finished — click to view the report.
notifications.importFailed: Your import failed. Click to see what happened.

version.newVersionOnDockerHub: A new version is available on
version.nativeUpdateRequiredDescription: Version {{version}} is available, but it needs a newer version of the app than the one installed. Please update Initiative from your app store or install the latest APK.

grantBanner.readOnly: You have temporary read-only access to {{guild}}.

readOnlyBanner.message: {{guild}} is currently read-only. You can browse everything, but changes are disabled.

billingSetup.opening: Opening billing so you can choose a plan for {{guild}}.

transferOwnership.title: Transfer ownership
transferOwnership.description: Move everything {{name}} owns in this guild to another admin.
transferOwnership.claimDescription: Give everything no current member owns to an admin.
transferOwnership.adminsOnly: Only guild admins can be given ownership.
transferOwnership.nothingOwned: They own nothing in this guild.
transferOwnership.nothingUnowned: Everything in this guild has an owner.
transferOwnership.loadFailed: Could not load what this person owns.

unownedContent.title: Unowned content
unownedContent.description: Content no current member owns — what a member leaving the guild leaves behind. Claim it to put an admin back in charge.
unownedContent.empty: Everything in this guild has an owner.

community.title: Communities
community.heroSubtitle: Whatever you're into, from tabletop to music to science, a guild here has a seat with your name on it.
community.emptyDescription: No guild here has listed itself in the directory. A guild admin can list theirs from guild settings.
community.noResultsDescription: No community matches “{{query}}”. Try another search or category.
community.unavailableDescription: The community directory could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.
community.disabledDescription: This deployment doesn't run a community directory. A platform owner can turn one on from platform settings.

publish.title: List this guild in the directory
publish.description: Anyone signed in will be able to find this guild and join it without an invite.
publish.categoriesHint: These decide where the guild shows up when people browse.
publish.certifyLabel: This guild contains no adult content
publish.certifyIntro: By listing this guild you certify that it contains none of the following:
publish.certifyMinors: Any sexual content involving a minor
publish.certifyIllegal: Illegal activity — drug use or sale, weapons, fraud, stolen goods
publish.certifyViolence: Graphic violence, gore, or encouragement of self-harm
publish.certifyDuty: You are an admin of this guild, so this is yours to enforce. You are expected to watch for this content and remove it. A guild that stops meeting this is removed from the directory.

nameDisplay.title: How members are named
nameDisplay.description: Whether this guild shows people's real names, or the usernames they chose.
nameDisplay.toggleHint: Off, members appear by username. On, their full name is shown where they have entered one.
nameDisplay.listedLock: A guild listed in the community directory always shows usernames.
